reviews.text:
I’ve been using Cox Pool Company for the past six months, and I couldn’t be happier with their service. They first helped me when my pool turned green—draining, cleaning, and restoring it back to perfect condition. Since then, they’ve provided reliable weekly service, keeping the water crystal clear and balanced.

Most recently, they converted my pool to a saltwater system and installed a new pool cleaner. Luke and his team were fantastic throughout the process. Luke is always willing to explain your options without being pushy, and he genuinely wants you to feel confident in your decisions. After the installation, he even came out personally to walk me through the new equipment and make sure I was comfortable with everything.

If you’re looking for a dependable, professional, and customer-focused pool company, I highly recommend Cox Pool Company!
reviews.author: Alex Belconis

reviews.text: Cox Pool Company is a fantastic family-owned business that truly cares about its customers. For the past two years, Luke Cox has been incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and dependable. His attention to detail and commitment to quality service make all the difference. Highly recommend this company for anyone who values honesty, expertise, and genuine care.
reviews.author: Trevor Matthews

reviews.text: Luke was awesome and taught me a lot about my pool! He was also patient. And they are so efficient and easy to get a hold of!! And it’s easy to get an appointment. And their prices are better! Thank you Cox Pools!!
reviews.author: Katy Haney

reviews.text:
I’m giving them 5 stars just for his kindness and knowledge helping me with which parts and pieces I needed for a project I’m working on. Lowe’s was zero help!
With his outstanding reviews I may have to try using his pool services as well! Thanks so much for your help!
reviews.author: TMInvestigates

reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with this company. A professional should be checking chemicals, not just relying on the salt system's readings. They let my salt levels get dangerously high, up to 6000 ppm, which has led to more costly issues I now have to pay for.
​After difficult discussions with the owner, it became clear they don't record the salt they add, which they use to their advantage. They're even trying to charge me more to troubleshoot my salt system, which is likely working poorly now because of the high salt during weeks. The owner refuses to take any accountability. Everyone should find a company they can trust, one that doesn't hide anything
reviews.author: Math Math

reviews.text: Highly recommend Cox Pool Company and their knowledge/experience in the field. Super easy to work with and will do right by you and your pool.
reviews.author: Caleb Paulson

reviews.text: Cox Pool Co helped me regain my trust in pool companies. From general upkeep to diagnosing issues ranging from simple to complex, they just seem to always have the right answers. Previous pool company left equipment in shambles, now Cox has this baby purring like a kitten. Going to be a great summer, thanks Cox Pools!
reviews.author: Brandon Cotter

reviews.text: I called Luke because my pool pump was leaking. He sent out his tech a few days later and changed a seal. He did a great job. Was fast very professional. I will use these guys again.

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The single detailed negative review on Google adds credibility, as it provides specific technical complaints and describes a conflict with the owner. The positive reviews are detailed, mention specific services and personnel, and reflect genuine customer experiences. The business appears to be a legitimate, family-owned operation with generally excellent service and a minor pattern of one type of chemical management complaint.
authentic_signals: Specific, detailed project descriptions (green pool recovery, saltwater conversion)
Mix of service types (maintenance, repair, installation)
One detailed negative review with specific technical claims (6000 ppm salt)
complaint_patterns: Salt level mismanagement leading to damage
Potential upselling/charging for troubleshooting caused by their error
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are generally consistent. Google's 4.9 is based on 32 reviews, Yelp's 4.1 on only 7 reviews, which is a small sample size and not a significant discrepancy. BBB A+ indicates good complaint handling.
